annotator_notes: Viedoc-style annotated eCRF, 1085 pages (a re-versioned twin of the 04 Jul 2023 book). Machine markers '[OID]'/'[TYPE:...]' precede human prompt labels; option values, '[Read-only field]', '[VISIBILITY:...]', 'Row N', and the 'Page N of 1085' footer are NOT fields. All ten sampled pages happen to be continuation pages (no printed form banner) - form_source=carryover throughout, so form accuracy is not scored on this document's sample; form_name is best-effort context from the bookmark tree.
